title: Author & Speaker in Poetry
skills: distinguish the author from the speaker in a poem
identify textual evidence that reveals the speaker's perspective
analyze how speaker identity shapes tone and meaning
avoid assuming that a poetic speaker directly represents the author's beliefs or experiences
alignment_note: Clarifies the distinction between a poem's author and its speaker or persona. Supports close reading, point-of-view analysis, interpretation of voice and tone, and more accurate evidence-based discussion of poetry across high school English courses.
